title: Necrotopia — Apocalypse in Las Vegas
blurb: A complete three-act apocalyptic Vegas road story: escape the chapel, choose the Silver Egg, and seal the hellmouth beneath Eternal Union.

vegas.name: Las Vegas — The Apocalypse
vegas.description: Neon and fire. The Strip is coming apart as the war between Heaven and Hell pours onto Earth.

sidequests.name: Act II — Vegas Side Stories
sidequests.description: Optional detours off the Strip: lay the Neon Follies chorus to rest, and settle accounts with the sentient casino known as the House.

artStyle: gritty apocalyptic Las Vegas, cinematic concept art, warm neon against grey ash
